integrity: The finite density set and automorphism counts are reproduced by the embedded standalone script. Infinite asymptotic claims are justified analytically using the fixed-subgraph threshold theorem and the strictly balanced Poisson limit. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only Boolean combinations of non-induced subgraph-occurrence properties for patterns on at most four vertices; this is not a maximum over all first-order sentences of quantifier depth four. The six nontrivial limits use standard threshold and strictly balanced Poisson theorems.
title: Exact six-point spectra in a bounded subgraph-query fragment
